allInheritedRecords.method: For each locus vary both expressed copies across the full legal range; hold every other trait fixed. Enable matching anatomy and expression gates. Compare actual SVG rendering and actual battle trajectories, energy, decisions and temporary effects across four seeds. For habitat drive genes, compare actual tank activity transitions over 300 simulated seconds.

otherTraits.remainingNumericTraits: Midpoint; neutral growth; no horn or special ability

verification.conditions: The win-rate sweep compares 1 versus 0.01 with other numeric traits at midpoints, neutral growth and no special anatomy. Motor and stride vary together for speed. Each of 300 seeds is repeated with corners swapped. Full expression tests vary every locus across its full legal range, with expression gates and relevant situations enabled. Habitat genes are separately checked against actual visits over 300 simulated seconds, with repeated drag interruptions for focus.
verification.interpretation: Traits have distinct roles and tradeoffs. A conditional trait can have a strong direct effect without increasing overall win rate in an arbitrary neutral matchup. Appearance genes change appearance; anatomy and suppressor gates can intentionally hide inherited potential.
